llm_response.reason: The website mixes online gambling promotions with spoofed e-commerce categories and branding (e.g., mimicking Lazada), contains urgent sign-up prompts and promises of unusually easy/guaranteed rewards, and redirects all critical user actions (login, register, live chat, etc.) to an unrelated external domain. These behaviors satisfy several scam website characteristics: use of non-existent or spoofed company information, urgency tactics, ambiguous information handling, mimicking legitimate brands, and inappropriate business hyperlinks.
